title: Customer names uppercase
statementMd:
Show customers in the city of Boston with their name in upper case.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT UPPER(name) AS name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Boston';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
